manual: Curated by hand in a Claude Code session on the subscription: the 3 Nov and 10 Nov CI curation runs were refused (401 on CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN), which left two tracked-case orders without gists and five candidates unclassified. Full texts fetched from the IK API and read.

classified.title: Kusumavati Gowda v. Government of Karnataka (2026 INSC 1030)
classified.reason: Fresh SIT investigation ordered into a 2012 rape and murder; matched only on 'golden hour' of a criminal investigation. Not a road-safety matter.

classified.title: Santosh Gurung v. State of Sikkim (2026 INSC 1073)
classified.reason: Acquittal in a POCSO/murder appeal; 'footpath' appears once in a witness's cross-examination. Not a road-safety matter.

classified.title: Vinod Mangaldas Shah v. IFFCO Tokio General Insurance (C.A. 13683/2026)
classified.reason: Individual MACT appeal: Bombay High Court order disposing of an insurer's interim application without notice to the claimants set aside for breach of natural justice and remitted. Fact-specific, no precedent for tribunals or insurers at large.

classified.title: Gurdev Singh v. State of Punjab (SLP(Crl.) 19816/2026)
classified.reason: Virtual appearance allowed for compromise verification in an IPC cross-case; matched only on counsel's phrase 'good Samaritans'. Not a road-safety matter.

classified.title: Shreeram Builders v. Upendra Kantilal Thanawala
classified.reason: Arbitration appeal over a development agreement; matched only on a citation to an NHAI arbitration precedent. Not a road-safety matter.
